main.description: Updates a channel's configuration. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.

name.description: The channel's name. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

description.description: The channel's topic. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

category.description: The category to move the channel to. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

linkEmbeds.description: Whether link previews are shown here. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

removeLinkEmbeds.description: Clears the channel's link preview setting so the community default applies. Ignored when linkEmbeds is also given.

permissionOverrides.description: Per-role and per-member permission overrides. Replaces the whole list. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the channel.update permission.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.

errors.name: CategoryNotFound
errors.description: No category matches the given record key.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The requesting user cannot grant a role that outranks their own.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
